description: Defines the AIConfiguration class with methods and members related to AI system configuration, including resource limits, enabled features, and system environment settings.

classes.name: AIConfiguration
classes.description: Class managing AI system configuration parameters, including resource limits, feature toggles, and environment settings.

methods.name: AIConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor for AIConfiguration class.

methods.name: virtual ~AIConfiguration
methods.description: Destructor for AIConfiguration class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the AIConfiguration instance.

methods.name: getContainerConsoleLogCap
methods.description: Returns the console log capacity.

methods.name: getAppsCpuSet
methods.description: Returns the CPU set for applications as a bitset.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppMemoryLimit
methods.description: Returns the memory limit for non-home applications.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppGpuLimit
methods.description: Returns the GPU limit for non-home applications.

methods.name: getVpuAccessBlacklist
methods.description: Returns the blacklist of VPU access.

methods.name: getAppsRequiringDBus
methods.description: Returns list of applications requiring D-Bus.

methods.name: getMapiPorts
methods.description: Returns list of MAPI ports.

methods.name: getResourceManagerClientEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if resource manager client is enabled.

methods.name: getGstreamerRegistryEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if GStreamer registry is enabled.

methods.name: getSvpEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if SVP is enabled.

methods.name: getEnableUsbMassStorage
methods.description: Indicates if USB mass storage is enabled.

methods.name: getIPv6Enabled
methods.description: Indicates if IPv6 is enabled.

methods.name: getIonHeapDefaultQuota
methods.description: Returns default quota for Ion heap.

methods.name: getDialServerPort
methods.description: Returns the dial server port.

methods.name: getDialServerPathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the dial server path prefix.

methods.name: getDialUsn
methods.description: Returns the dial USN.

methods.name: getIonHeapQuotas
methods.description: Returns map of Ion heap quotas.

methods.name: printAIConfiguration
methods.description: Prints the current AI configuration.

methods.name: readFromCustomData
methods.description: Reads configuration data from custom source.

methods.name: readFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads configuration data from a file.

methods.name: readGlobalEnv
methods.description: Reads global environment variables.
